headline: Today's sound headlines
lead: 30 new stories from 17 sound and audio news sources over the last 48 hours, including Sound On Sound, Production Expert, ProSoundWeb, FOH, TPi and 12 more. This edition is assembled automatically from the outlets' own feeds: titles and summaries are theirs, sorted into sections. Open a story for the full article.

items.title: ClipMap Review: Is This The Multi-Session Pro Tools Fix?
items.take: ClipMap from Sparks Audio seeks to solve the issue of Pro Tools only allowing one session to be open at a time. ClipMap reads .ptx sessions directly, allowing you to browse, audition, and retrieve material and import it into your currently open session in Pro Tools.

craft.body:
Two stories this week come back to one question: who owns and who has cleared the audio you touch. That covers a Suno cue a director drops into the cut, a stem you separate from a master, and a board recording you make at a gig.

Add two short lines to your standard quote: the client confirms all supplied material is cleared, and the quote states who owns any recordings you make on the job. It takes five minutes once and protects you on every job after.
craft.title: Put the rights question in writing
